text:
mira: FYI — nightly secret-scan found a KMS-wrapped partner credential pasted into a CI log for partner=zenpay. It looks like ciphertext but the accessor was logged. Need containment + decision on rewrap vs full rotation.
ops-bot: secret-detect v3.0: 1 match in ci-logs. report: https://internal/reports/1712009999 (automated) :warning:
sam: can you paste the redacted line and when it showed up?
mira: redacted: `2026-03-22T23:45:02Z DEBUG vault:get secret=data/partners/zenpay/webhook cipher=ci:enc:... accessor=va..-abc123` last seen 2026-03-22T23:45:02Z
leo: quick context: we store the partner key at KVv2 path `secret/data/partners/zenpay/webhook` and we wrap with KMS key `rw/partner-zenpay`. The ciphertext in logs is the wrapped blob; accessor leaked could allow lookup if someone has Vault token.
security_oncall: assume worst-case. Immediate actions: 1) restrict Vault policy so that only a tiny set of service accounts can read the path, 2) rotate the secret (create a fresh secret path), 3) rotate or rekey the KMS key if warranted, 4) add audit sinks and trace reads since the accessor appeared. I'll open SEC-2026-99.
sam: question — if only the accessor leaked (not plaintext), is rewrap OK? Rewrap changes encryption but keeps same plaintext. If the leak is the wrapped data + accessor, an attacker with Vault API + token could fetch. So rotation is safer.
leo: agree — rewrap is low value here. Plan: write a new secret to `secret/data/partners/zenpay/webhook-v2`, generate a new secret value, wrap with the same KMS key for now, and then rotate the KMS key later if partner asks. Update consumers to fallback-read v2 then retire old path.
mira: partner ops replied: they cannot rotate immediately; they request proof-of-exposure and a short TTL proxy from our side. I propose issuing an ephemeral outbound token and blocking long-lived tokens.
security_oncall: RBAC change draft (vault CLI):
```vault policy write deny-zenpay-old - <<'EOF'
path "secret/data/partners/zenpay/webhook" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
EOF
```
I'll gate it behind owner ack. After deny we can create ephemeral tokens for debugging (ttl=30m).
sam: I'll queue a rotation job and a canary rollout for the secret-agent. Rotation sketch: generate new key, `vault kv put secret/data/partners/zenpay/webhook-v2 key=$NEWKEY rotated_by=automation`, update config and restart agent in canary namespace.
leo: also prepare a terraform tiny change for the policy + rolebinding to reduce blast radius. Keep minimal to fast-track.
mira: audit steps: enable file audit device if not present, export KMS admin logs to security project, and run a lookup for any Vault token reads referencing accessor `va..-abc123` in the last 30d. Need those IOCs for partner.
security_oncall: post-rotation checklist: 1) expire old KV versions, 2) revoke tokens that had read capability, 3) run a full log scan across CI/artifacts for other occurrences, 4) deliver IOCs to zenpay and document timeline in SEC-2026-99.
ops-bot: rotation pipeline `rotations/partners/zenpay/1712009999` queued by sam. Reminder scheduled in 15m.
mira: assigning: sam -> run rotation CI + canary; leo -> RBAC + terraform diff; security_oncall -> incident and audit; mira -> partner comms and IOCs. I'll attach PoA to the incident when complete. Thanks.
